name: Permanent Resident status

requirements.blocker_text: This requires holding an eligible work pass (Employment Pass, S Pass, ONE Pass, or Tech.Pass) — no fixed minimum holding period is published; assessment is holistic and criteria are not fully disclosed by ICA.

requirement_groups.name: Global Investor Programme — Option A (business investment)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires investing at least S$10,000,000 in a new or existing Singapore business entity, employing at least 30 workers (at least half Singaporean, at least 10 new hires), with at least 3 years' entrepreneurial track record.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required capital and meet the employment-creation criteria.

requirement_groups.name: Global Investor Programme — Option B (fund investment)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires investing at least S$25,000,000 into an EDB-approved GIP-select fund that invests in Singapore-based companies.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required capital.

requirement_groups.name: Global Investor Programme — Option C (Single Family Office)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires establishing a Singapore-based Single Family Office with at least S$200,000,000 in total assets under management, with at least S$50,000,000 deployed into EDB-specified local investments.
requirements.fix_path: Establish the qualifying Single Family Office structure.

evidence_required.document: Employment pass history and income tax records (PTS route)
Audited financial statements and investment evidence (GIP route)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite; Re-Entry Permit (travel document) renewed every 5 or 10 years
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: GIP holders must maintain genuine Singapore presence (commonly cited as at least 50% of the year) and continued business/investment substance to retain the Re-Entry Permit, though PR status itself may continue even if the permit lapses

sources.title: Applying for permanent residence - Immigration & Checkpoints Authority
Global Investor Programme - Singapore Economic Development Board

notes: MAJOR STRUCTURAL FINDING, one of the largest confirmed threshold jumps in this entire multi-country dataset by proportional scale: the Global Investor Programme's fund-route (Option B) threshold rose from S$2,500,000 to S$25,000,000 — a TEN-FOLD increase — with the business-investment route (Option A) set at S$10,000,000. Multiple current sources explicitly flag the old S$2.5M figure as 'obsolete' and 'still circulating online,' confirming this is a genuine, live, high-confidence counterfeit-figure case comparable in significance to Japan's Business Manager visa 6x jump. GIP application fee confirmed at S$20,000 (from May 2025) — a real, distinctive non-refundable application cost not seen on other countries' investor routes in this dataset at this scale relative to the investment itself. HONEST GAP, flagged deliberately rather than papered over: the PTS group's requirement genuinely has no disclosed minimum holding period, salary threshold, or points formula — ICA assesses holistically on undisclosed criteria including salary, qualifications, age, family profile, and economic contribution, and Singapore is well-known for NOT publishing PR approval criteria the way most other countries in this dataset do. This is a materially different situation from routes elsewhere in this dataset with a genuine sourcing gap (like Portugal's Blue Card salary) — here the opacity is a deliberate government policy choice, not a research shortfall, and this file states that honestly rather than inventing a plausible-sounding number. citizenship_after_months (24) reflects the commonly-cited approximate 2-year PR-to-citizenship-eligibility figure, itself also not a fixed guarantee — actual naturalisation remains discretionary (see sg_naturalisation).
